title: sieve: RFC 5228 evaluator core
description: Implement crates/sieve/src/eval.rs. Public struct Evaluator. Public trait MessageContext: provides fn headers(&self, name: &str) -> Vec<&str>; fn envelope_from(&self) -> &str; fn envelope_to(&self) -> &str; fn body_size(&self) -> u64. Evaluate SieveScript against a &dyn MessageContext, producing Vec<SieveAction> (enum: Keep, Discard, FileInto(String), Reject(String)). Walk commands top to bottom. If command: evaluate test, if true execute then-block, else try elsif chain, else execute else_block. Stop: return immediately with current action list (implicit Keep if no fileinto/discard/reject was produced). Require: check declared extensions set; if extension not known to the evaluator, return EvalError::UndeclaredExtension. Tests: headertest(:is), headertest(:contains), headertest(:matches) with glob wildcards (* = zero-or-more chars, ? = single char per RFC 5228 §2.7.3), address test (:all, :localpart, :domain), allof/anyof/not, size:over/size:under, exists, if/elsif/else branching, stop terminates, implicit keep when no action. Oracle: Dovecot Pigeonhole test suite test cases for these conditions.
